class.name: NNActions
class.description: Shared base node for actions executed under an [NNBehaviour]. Provides [member is_finished] and [member has_failed] flags for tracking action completion.

members.member: Set to [code]true[/code] along with [member is_finished] to signal that this action failed. Reset automatically when the action starts and after it exits.
Set to [code]true[/code] when the action is done so the parent [NNBehaviour] or [NNActionGroup] can advance to the next action. Reset automatically when the action starts and after it exits.
